//: The browser suite (SPA-184, ship-6; docs/spec-plugin-sdk.md §13.8). Playwright against the app as CI runs it: `vite build`'s apps/web/.output served by node, booted by apps/web/src/db/boot.ts against a database this harness creates and drops. It imports nothing internal — no `@spaces/*`, no `#/` — because it tests the product from outside, over HTTP and through a real Chromium; the eslint zone in packages/config/eslint.base.js holds that. The two workspace packages it reaches, it reaches as processes (the boot entry and the server bundle), never as modules. No `test` script on purpose: `pnpm test` is the unit suite and stays exactly that; `pnpm e2e` is this. Playwright is a devDependency of this package and of nothing that ships — the image's prune scopes (@spaces/web, @spaces/worker) cannot reach it.
name: @spaces/e2e
